sequence_definition: 32 x 51 explicit class-agnostic channels: 16 Skeleton relation/delta, 25 IMU invariant, 10 Depth/IR motion/context

training.checkpoint_policy: fixed final epoch; no inner-held trajectory selection

development_hypothesis: The 32-step explicit sequence contains order-dependent conditional information, but R2 lost it through scalar supervision, mean/max pooling and a global small residual. A sample-adaptive gate with phase-preserving segment states should add information while retaining the legal base.
iteration_decision: Continue if event_sequence improves mean Hard over the same base_only architecture with at least two positive folds, or if causal ablations show stable unused information that motivates a better decision objective. Do not evaluate fold-0 outer-held.
